stage: Phase B and final combined asset

leaves.method: The generator appends all 240 leaf patches before stem and grass geometry. Compared those exact leading position, index, normal and color blocks.

gravel.note: Matched pieces by unchanged shoulder-ring and tip positions; top triangles match position, linear color, normal and winding. Baseline 44ce1cc vegetation/gravel are identical to Phase A.

sourceBlend.method: Opened saved .blend in background Blender 5.2.3 LTS with automatic script execution disabled; inspected without saving before browser benchmarking.

limitations: Geometry checks use numerical data; rendered material quality and timing are recorded by matched browser QA.
Node GLTFLoader check stubs bitmap decode; its color-space and numeric attribute checks are exact, while browser QA covers actual texture rendering.
The underside has 79 open edges at its concealed upper rim join; it is one connected shell with no nonmanifold edges.
